name: 2026-06 macro hypothesis (UNVERIFIED — a stance to TEST, not advice)
notes: Encodes a user-stated macro view as tunable tilts: AI-selloff + inflation + oil/Iran. Multipliers >1 boost a name's signal score, <1 fade it, 0 exclude it. THIS IS A HYPOTHESIS. Backtest it on the constant-mix harness over recent rolling 8-week windows and compare vs the no-thesis baseline before trusting it. Note the internal tension: 'high oil' favours oil_beta, but 'problems resolve' implies oil FALLS (favouring oil consumers) — pick ONE coherent direction and set tilts accordingly. Tags must be assigned per-name in the universe CSV; sectors use GICS-style names.
